descriptionByLocale.it: Job Description The opportunity We are looking for a passionate and proficient industrial specialist with expertise in power system analysis\/ management and high-level programming. In an inter-disciplinary environment, you will drive cutting-edge innovation for different complex systems in power grid applications. Join our dynamic and motivated team to contribute to a sustainable energy future for all. How you'll make an impact You create impact: Together with your team design innovative approaches for grid operation and deliver them as robust software modules You investigate: Translate real power‑system problems into rigorous models and final solutions for the customers You take initiative: Collaborate with a global and inter-disciplinary team of researchers and engineers in Hitachi Energy to drive the development from concept to production You connect: Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise. Interact with local and global external partners including universities, start-ups, and vendors to integrate diverse perspectives and stakeholder inputs You communicate: Be able to clearly communicate concepts to software developers, implementation engineering teams and customers. Produce clear design docs and developer-facing examples\/ notebooks that enable reuse. Your background Master Electrical\/Power Systems Engineering, Automation, Computer Science, Mathematics, or Master's degree with equivalent industry experience Proven expertise in modelling and steady-state analyses of power grids demonstrated hands-on expertise applying these methods in software development. Knowledge in mathematical optimization applied to power systems, and modern numerical solvers is strongly desired (e.g., MIP\/NLP, stochastic; tools such as Gurobi, CPLEX, Ipopt). Experience with machine learning and\/or artificial intelligence technologies is a plus Proficiency in C#, C++, Rust or a similar high-level programming language is required; Python and\/or Matlab for analytics and fast prototyping are a plus. Experience building state-of-the-art software engineering techniques (version control, code reviews, testing, CI\/CD) and integrating solution algorithms into applications are beneficial (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes). High performance computing skills such as parallel\/distributed computing, GPU, OpenMP or MPI would be beneficial Excellent communication skills in English, team player attitude, initiative and creativity More about us We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefits to support your financial, physical and mental wellbeing and personal development. We want you to truly thrive with us, in work and out. We can provide more information during the recruitment process. Are you ready for a new exciting challenge? Does the above description sound like you? Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so don't delay – apply today! Dbamy o przejrzystość i zgodność z wymogami prawnymi tak, aby każda osoba uczestnicząca w procesie rekrutacyjnym wiedziała, czego może się spodziewać na poszczególnych etapach. Po pomyślnym zakończeniu procesu przedstawimy wybranej osobie szczegóły dotyczące warunków finansowych oraz benefitów. Pozostałe elementy oferty zostaną przekazane przed podpisaniem umowy o pracę, tak by stworzyć możliwość spokojnego zapoznania się z nimi. * Klauzula obowiązuje wyłącznie na terenie Polski , zgodnie z lokalnymi przepisami prawa. We are committed to full transparency and compliance with all legal requirements, ensuring that every candidate knows exactly what to expect at each stage of the recruitment process. Once the process is successfully completed, we will share detailed information about financial conditions and benefits with the selected candidate. Before signing the employment contract, you will receive all remaining details of the offer, giving you the time and space to review everything carefully. *Applicable only for Poland lo
